earlier_scan.note: Unattested extinct language (Tanzania); ISO retired 2008 as non-existent; no documentation exists.

sources.note: "an extinct, apparently unattested Bantu language" near Lake Victoria; Guthrie JE.407; code 'deprecated in 2008 as spurious'; cites only Glottolog and ISO change request 2007-024. Great Lakes Bantu article lists it with a '?' under Logooli-Kuria (E40).

sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Bibliographic records only. 74876 lists Ware as 'P 12/131 Ware [wre]' (a people-list entry, keywords j.e.407) among Ngurimi, Masai, Iraqw, Somali, Sandawe, Hadza etc; 22309 (Sommer 1992) has a one-page section 'Ware (397)' in its language-death survey. Neither record implies any phonological data.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid page and JSON for ware1252 (Hammarström et al.), read 2026-09-17.
sources.note: No linguistic content. Category 'Unattested' (pseudo-family unat1236 > 'Atlantic-Congo (Unattested)' atla1280); iso_retirement reason 'non-existent'; Glottolog's fullest description is only a wordlist on the strength of Tucker & Bryan 1956 (ref 74876); AES extinct.

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2007. Change Request Number 2007-024: adopted retire [wre] (2008-01-14). Submitted by Mark Woodward & Susanne Krueger (SIL-UTB). Dallas: SIL International. 8 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing about language structure at all. p. 2, section 3(c): "Neither we, the SIL-UTB survey team, nor any other people we have spoken to have heard of the Ware people.. the UTB survey team was in Mara Region, Tanzania where many of the languages in the E.10 group to which Ware is said to belong are located, and found no knowledge of the Ware.. we would recommend retiring this language code element." Section (c) 'Knowledge from published sources' is blank.

sources.citation: Sommer, Gabriele. 1992. A Survey on Language Death in Africa. In M. Brenzinger (ed.), Language Death, 301-413. Berlin: Mouton de Gruyter. Section 'Ware', p. 397.
